name: Reflect
description: A single reflection about the vertical, with the two halves in different inks.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 100% 0, 100% 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 100% 0, 100% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@x > @X / 2) { -webkit-transform: scaleX(-1); transform: scaleX(-1); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
